_doc: Running gear the game draws as bogie sprites (rolling/bogie_<style>_f<f>), built by running_gear.bogie. Positions are metres in the game frame: x along the track from the pivot the game hangs the group at (+ towards the vehicle's front), heights above the rail. scale sizes the details (and wheels given as d, real metres); d_f is a wheel diameter already in the game frame. Wheels always sit on the game's rails (+-0.16 tile); other parts keep their real distance outboard of the rail, widened as the gauge is. Steam coupled wheels shrink until they clear each other at the measured, compressed spacing; everything under one engine shares that factor. Colours are sRGB 0-255, medians of boxes on the source crops (source_px).

leading.rides_under: flying_scotsman engine, front pivot (+2.727 m); also A4, DRG 01, K4s, Black Five, MAV 424, Daylight, GMAM
leading.note: measured leading wheels l1/l2 at +1.882/+2.707 m on the engine: centre 0.4325 m behind the front pivot; A3 bogie wheels 0.97 m x 0.61

pacific.rides_under: flying_scotsman engine, rear pivot (-2.727 m); also A4, DRG 01, K4s
pacific.note: coupled wheels at the measured d1/d2/d3 (-1.465/-0.13/+1.25 m on the engine), drawn from the rear pivot; A3 drivers 2.03 m and trailing wheels 1.12 m x 0.61 clear each other at the 1.34 m spacing; no frames: the group swings about the rear pivot on curves, so only wheels and rods go with it; the frames are a skirt on the body; the cylinders stay with the body

uk_tender_pair.rides_under: flying_scotsman tender, both pivots (+-1.543 m); also A4, Black Five, 9F
uk_tender_pair.note: two axles 0.7 m apart about the pivot, 1.27 m tender wheels x 0.5 so the outer wheels stay under the tender's 4.28 m sprite; the tender's own outside frame, axle boxes and springs stay with its body above 0.78 m

htc.note: EMD HT-C at the game's pivot: real 1.016 m wheels, 1.1 m apart (the source's 0.93 m would make them touch) so the truck still ends inside the body; cast side frames, journal boxes, coil spring pairs, bolster

blomberg.note: EMD Blomberg B at the game's pivot: the source's axle spacing (1.93 m after the F7's 0.788 compression, measured) with real 1.016 m wheels; cast side frame with pedestals, swing-hanger coil spring nest outboard at the bolster, journal boxes
